_description: Config for CT Chest (with contrast) party macro conversion. Universal rules (Rules/universal_rules.json) always run first; additionalRules below run after, for chest/cardiac-specific edits.
name: CT Chest

examMatch._note: Verified 2026-08-12 against a real copied header ("CT CHEST WITH CONTRAST"). Deliberately narrow -- does NOT match "CT CHEST PULMONARY ANGIOGRAM" or other chest protocols.

_measurementUnitNote: Defaulted to mm since pulmonary nodules are conventionally reported in mm. Change to "cm" if that's not the preference.

sections._note: sourceLabel may be a single label or an array of fallback labels tried in order. Confirmed against your real HARM CT Chest template.

conditionalOmit: Coronary is a live picklist field in the template and is left untouched by default. Confirmed against your real QM logic -- scans the Mediastinum text specifically (not the whole report) for the word 'coronary', since that's exactly where coronary language lands when the HARM Coronary picklist is filled in and appended to the Mediastinum sentence during dictation. If found, the standalone Coronary field is stripped from the party output as redundant.
